description: Search the Trailhead Supply catalogue the way its search page does: by words or a model number, within a category or brand, by price in USD, in stock only, and by spec filters. Each product comes with its page URL, photo, price, stock line, key specs and category. The answer also gives the total, the same results' URL on the store's website, suggested_filters (categories and spec values with how many products each would leave) and, when nothing matches, did_you_mean with categories and products the store offers instead.

category.description: A category slug from list_categories or suggested_filters.

filters.description: Spec filters from suggested_filters: code => list of values, e.g. {"color": ["black"]}; a numeric spec also takes "min~max". At most 6 codes of 8 values each.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

query.description: Words or a model number. Required unless category or brand is given.

sort.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc or newest.

name: search_products

answer_type.description: What this answer is, for rendering.

did_you_mean.description: Only when nothing matched: what the store suggests instead.

branches.description: The stores or warehouses holding it, each with its state. Empty when the store does not say.

label.description: The stock line the store's website shows, in the answer language.

badges.description: For example new, sale or featured.

amount.description: The price a visitor pays, in the card's currency; null when on request or not on sale.

compare_at.description: The higher crossed-out price of a sale.

on_request.description: True: the price is given on request (call or message the store).

public_id.description: Pass it to get_product or compare_products.

url.description: The product page on the store's website, in the answer language; cite it.

code.description: "category": pass a value as the category argument; any other code: pass values in filters[code].

truncated.description: Present and true only when the answer outgrew the size budget and its last list items were left out; ask narrower to see them.

url.description: These results on the store's website.
